lines.text: Private sales, folks! No dealers! No Rex! Just honest people selling honest things! Linda?

lines.speaker: Linda from Accounts
lines.text: For sale. One staircase, slightly too long. Takes you one floor further than you need. You will not be told what's on that floor.

lines.speaker: Linda from Accounts
lines.text: For sale. Hot air balloon. Only flown once. Still flying. Please collect.

lines.speaker: Linda from Accounts
lines.text: Free. One kitten, three eyes, very good at noticing things. Will notice things about you. Will be kind about it.

lines.speaker: Linda from Accounts
lines.text: For sale. A Grumbel's Ladder, the Ambition model. Selling because I would like to come down now. Please send help. Please send a ladder.

lines.speaker: Rex Bellows
lines.text: Ooh. I'll take the ladder. Linda, put me down for the ladder.
